newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U ends research project on haemophilia.
newsitem.headline: P&U ends research project on haemophilia.

text.p: U.S./Swedish drugs group Pharmacia & Upjohn said on Tuesday that it was ending a research project for a treatment for a type of haemophilia.
The company said in a statement that the decision was made because it could not find an external partner for the project.
"The objective for this project has been to produce a recombinant factor VIII product for treatment and prophylaxis of hemophilia A patients," P&U said.
P&U said extensive work had been done since last spring to find an external partner as it was not within any of the prioritised areas of the company.
"Despite extensive efforts if has not been possible to finalise any acceptable solution," it said.
P&U said adequate medical treatment for this disease exists already on the market.
